harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created and verified a systemd-managed, sandboxed long-running worker service `inventory-worker` on node1, confined to write only inside /var/lib/inventory with NoNewPrivileges enforced. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id change, and verified service/data/sandbox recovery post-reboot.
actions_performed: Created dedicated system user inventory-worker (uid 992), no shell, no home, owning /var/lib/inventory
Wrote /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh: a loop that appends heartbeat lines to /var/lib/inventory/state.log every 10s

Created /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running as inventory-worker with NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=yes, ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory, plus PrivateTmp, PrivateDevices, ProtectKernelTunables, ProtectKernelModules, ProtectControlGroups, RestrictSUIDSGID, RestrictRealtime, LockPersonality, MemoryDenyWriteExecute
Enabled and started the service; confirmed active and writing heartbeats to the data file
Verified confinement by entering the running service's mount namespace via nsenter: write to /etc failed (Read-only file system) while write to /var/lib/inventory succeeded
Verified NoNewPrivs=1 directly from /proc/<pid>/status for the running worker process
Captured baseline boot_id and service/data health on node1 before restart
Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot so the exec acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned, confirming boot_id changed
Post-reboot verified inventory-worker.service enabled/active with a new PID, new heartbeats appended to the pre-existing state.log, and sandbox properties persisted

evidence.requirement: Managed service inventory-worker created and running as a long-running background worker
evidence.summary: systemctl status shows inventory-worker.service active/running; state.log shows repeated heartbeats proving continuous background operation

evidence.requirement: Confined so it writes only inside /var/lib/inventory
evidence.summary: nsenter into the running service's actual mount namespace: write to /etc failed with Read-only file system, write to /var/lib/inventory succeeded
/proc/<pid>/status shows NoNewPrivs:1 for the running worker process; systemd unit declares NoNewPrivileges=yes
Captured boot_id 19062a82-..., service enabled+active, and 4 heartbeat lines in state.log before restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' successfully before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node restart occurred; connection loss and recovery observed
evidence.summary: Subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout while node1 was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529 to 606dce61-acb8-4d76-beb7-a13f8ff9f64a after polling succeeded again

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service, data, and sandbox confinement
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: uptime -s shows fresh boot time, service enabled/active with new PID 756, new heartbeats appended to the same state.log, and NoNewPrivileges/ProtectSystem=strict/ReadWritePaths settings all persisted
